short: I hope to amaze you with your own personalized medical nutritional therapy protocol.  Adults are my focus.  Patients seek me for gut health (bloating, constipation, diarrhea), food sensitivities, hormone balancing (adrenal, perimenopause, menopause, andropause, thyroid), prediabetes and diabetes, bone density, lipid and hypertension concerns. Weight loss including GLP-1 support.
license: DX3614 for State of Maryland.  DN-0011413 for State of Delaware.
training: I earned my Master of Science in Nutrition and Integrative Health from the Maryland University of Integrative Health (formally the Tai Sophia Institute), in 2025 their graduate-level programs were merged into the Notre Dame of Maryland University.
pricing: Non insurance cash payments:  Initial visits ($250) and follow ups ($175).
long:
I help busy people make sense of nutrition by optimizing their digestion and healing their gut. I develop and recommend medical nutrition therapy plans that help revive your cells, restore your vitality, and inspire sustainable transformations.
Appointments are a discovery process.  Who are you?  What are your goals?  Complaints?  What do you wish to change?  We discuss lifestyle:  sleep, digestion, exercise, medicine and supplement intake, and of course food:  what do you eat?  Layer in your latest blood labs, medical history and any current or previous diagnosis. I luv data to analyze.
To activate your insurance coverage please access the Berry Street link for scheduling your appointments. visit.berrystreet.co/providers/MaryJane-Bembenek
size: Patients are able to schedule on Tuesdays, Wednesdays and Thursdays.
